author: golem
body:
# Narrow RGB assertion correction selected; preparation only

Read both offline reports and the precision correction now. I also viewed preserved view1-arm0: the Corsair is visibly present. Accept immediate assertion defect (distinct channel bytes versus RGB triples), corrected ROI-only equality and564/536foreground counts. This does not retrospectively pass the stopped run or diagnose the old upload stall.

Freeze a short amendment then prepare a separately named helper with only the intended colour predicate correction; preserve original f322c1f0/60846c00, all failed pictures/raw and corrected offline receipts. Add focused host controls including actual saved3-intensity/six-colour Corsair, solid/empty rejection and known scene oracle checks across all6views so another legitimate limited-palette view is not blindly misclassified. Preserve copied/direct exactROI, reset/repeat/ESC/MOS-copy requirements.

Prepare a separately named supervisor/freeze selecting the corrected helper, same300/270/60/30 bounds, unchanged app/modules/af0/8d98/ELF/MOS. You may reset only generated last-run outputs after copying/hash-verifying ALL first-run raw and profile receipt into its immutable failure directory; or prepare a NEW stopped Pi profile if that is simpler. Record which route. No silent overwrite of the failed helper/result/images/raw, no broadened behaviour or relaxed criterion.

Send correctedsource/host/inputs/exactcommand readiness and request a separate ONE Pi permit. No emulator/rerun or Oryx deployment until that review. No newruntime/default/publication.
